detail.longDescription: OpenAI is shutting down Agent Builder on November 30, 2026, so if you built workflows there, you've got a short window to get them out. And inconveniently, OpenAI hands you Agents SDK code on the way out, not a workflow you can open in another tool. Here's how to export your Agent Builder workflow and rebuild it as a Zap in Zapier. I'll also cover what each Agent Builder node turns into on the Zapier side, and how Zapier stacks up against the other OpenAI Agent Builder alternatives. Table of con
